_comment: FNIRSI 2D15P V2.7.0.7 — DMM-first mod. Offsets are FILE offsets (MCU addr - 0x11000). See notes/re-plan.md 2026-10-05 for derivation.

patches.note: Goal 1: boot page = 1 (DMM) instead of 2 (scope) when config magic is 0x55. init @0x3668E: movs r3,#2 -> movs r3,#1
Goal 3a: DDS key handler @0x2CA70: 'cmp r0,#3' -> 'cmp r0,#1' so pressing it on the DMM page returns to scope
Goal 3b: DDS key handler @0x2CA7E: 'b.w 0x49880' (enter DDS) -> 'b.w 0x49924' (enter DMM); touch-menu DDS entry untouched

Goal 3c: LED refresh 0x300B4 tail @0x3011C..0x30161 rewritten: DDS LED (word 0x2000341A bit 0x800, active-low) lit when page==1 (DMM) OR generator output +0x450==1; Run/Stop green/red logic for pages 1/2/3 unchanged
Goal 3d: Menu key (type-1 id 13, handler 0x2C9E0) @0x2C9F6: 'cmp r0,#2; it ne; pop{r7,pc}' -> 'cmp r0,#2; bne.w 0x30162' (non-scope pages go to the cave)

Goal 3d cave @0x30162..0x3016F (REQUIRES patch 3, reuses the old tail of 0x300B4): page 1 (DMM) -> bl 0x472D0 (enter scope) + bl 0x470D8 (open main menu, same as scope Menu); other pages -> pop {r7,pc} as stock
